name: Generate a complete build brief
description: Verifies a prospective client can provide project context and receive a portable build brief with a send action.
steps: Scroll to the Start a build section
Enter business name "Northstar Dental" and email "owner@example.com"
Select "Generate qualified leads" as the primary goal and submit the form
expected: A visible BUILD BRIEF READY result appears containing Northstar Dental and an Email artificialBRIDGE action.

name: Reject a build brief without ownership details
description: Verifies the build brief cannot be generated when the business name and email are missing.
steps: Scroll to the Start a build section
Leave Business name and Email empty
expected: A visible validation message asks for the business name and email, and no BUILD BRIEF READY result is shown.

name: Use the mobile navigation to reach the method
description: Verifies mobile visitors can open navigation and move to the build method without a desktop-only menu dependency.
expected: The mobile menu closes and the THE METHOD section is visible.

name: Switch the live website showcase mode
description: Verifies the hero demonstration changes its content when the visitor selects a different website system mode.
steps: Locate the live-build demonstration in the hero
Read the demonstration headline and tags
expected: The demonstration changes to the CONVERSION SYSTEM state and shows the headline "Turn attention into a clear next action."

name: Show the current artificialBRIDGE motion identity
description: Verifies the approved site includes the current artificialBRIDGE identity system without replacing the rest of the site.
steps: Inspect the three brand motion cards
expected: The section shows FULL MOTION SIGNATURE, SPAN / LOADER EXECUTION, and CONNECTOR / APP ICON with the current broken-arch Span identity; the connection point is a larger solid gold circle and emits an outward gold ring that fades after connection.
